items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, do you know Percy Humphrey? [INTERVIEWEE] Did he play with them?

ctx.x: He was the one with the little sack on his shoulder carrying all the music.

Yeah. Well, you know, speaking of that, Percy Humphrey, that reminds me of something else that I wanted to tell you about. That in, it would have been in the late 60s, I guess, in my little community of Harrisonburg, Virginia, which is nearby a place called Bridgewater, which has Bridgewater College. And I thought that Bridgewater College sponsored an appearance of a Preservation Hall jazz band in February one year. And these signs went up, and I was excited about that.
